=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the left-most face in a Facebook photograph posted 2 May 2021. The Facebook photo viewer names Roberto Borias. Identification: exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/roberto.borias). The same face is the repeating subject across several pictures on that profile. From Chicago, Illinois; Tinley Park is a Chicago suburb. The uncropped original is a two-person bar photograph; the other person is not dested as the lead. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Roberto Borias portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Roberto Borias Facebook portrait.jpg]].
